historical_freeze_ordering.command: find . -type f -name '*.driver.log' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
historical_freeze_ordering.semantics: GNU sort -z under the inherited host collation environment; the 2026-09-09 command did not set LC_ALL=C. The same host read back en_US.UTF-8 on 2026-09-23, and the exact historical command reproduced every frozen digest.

v11_ordering.implementation: Python sorted() over normalized relative-path strings
v11_ordering.semantics: Bytewise ordering for the registered ASCII path set.

required_v12_check: A future v12 design must verify both the historical locale-ordered digest and a separately frozen bytewise digest before parsing any candidate rows.
